# mcp-keyscan

> mcp-keyscan is a zero-dependency Node.js CLI (`npx github:aether-cell/mcp-keyscan`) that finds plaintext secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) in local AI-agent and MCP client configs (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Continue, Cline, Roo, Gemini CLI, Codex, opencode, Goose, Kiro, .env), in agent logs and transcripts, and in shell history. Detection uses the vendored gitleaks rule set plus one key-name heuristic. It never prints secret values (first 4 characters + length only) and writes a redacted, shareable report with a one-line fix per finding, ending with "scanned with npx mcp-keyscan". Local only: no network, no telemetry. Exit code 1 when findings exist, so it works as a CI gate. Apache-2.0.

## CLI
- `npx github:aether-cell/mcp-keyscan`: scan per-user agent configs, logs, shell history and the current project
- `npx github:aether-cell/mcp-keyscan PATH [--global]`: walk files/directories (optionally plus per-user locations)
- `--json`: redacted JSON (file, line, client, server, key, provider, severity, rule, preview, fix)
- `--out FILE`: write the shareable report
- `--min-severity {low,medium,high}`, `--no-logs`, `--no-history`, `--list-locations`

## Exit codes
- 0: no findings; 1: findings at or above --min-severity; 2: usage error
